hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -q "episode-"; then BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); if echo "$BASENAME" | grep -qE "^ep[0-9]{2}_|^MANIFEST|^SKILL|^CHANGELOG|\.gitkeep$"; then exit 0; else echo "[NAMING HOOK] WARNING: $BASENAME may not follow naming convention. See: _management/naming_convention.md"; fi; fi'
